description: This file defines the HomeFragment class, which implements the main Android TV home screen UI using RecyclerView components. It includes setup for top navigation and content rails with mock data, focusing on focus navigation, accessibility, and theme adherence.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment representing the Android TV home screen, managing navigation, content display, and focus behavior.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout using view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the top navigation and content rails after view creation.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Configures the horizontal RecyclerView for top categories including focus handling and initial focus positioning.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Initializes mock data and sets up vertical list of content rows with horizontal scrolling for content cards.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears binding reference to avoid memory leaks.
